subject: Torch Red US 3LZ, closed, index 8

subject: Torch Red US 3LZ, closed, index 11

subject: Torch Red US 3LZ, closed, index 12
note: The rear bumper and outer lights line up with the back of the left tire. The lower diffuser has a smoother transition.

subject: Torch Red US 3LZ, closed, index 13

subject: Torch Red US 3LZ, closed, index 14

subject: Torch Red US 3LZ, closed, index 16

subject: Torch Red US 3LZ, closed, index 17

subject: Torch Red US 3LZ, closed, index 18

subject: Torch Red US 3LZ, closed, index 19

subject: Torch Red US 3LZ, closed, index 20

subject: Torch Red US 3LZ, closed, index 21

subject: Torch Red US 3LZ, closed, index 22

subject: Torch Red US 3LZ, closed, index 23
note: The long hood and rear-deck proportions agree from this side. The inner headlamp guides have simplified facets.

subject: Torch Red US 3LZ, closed, index 24
note: The windscreen rake and near front wheel align. The inset across the door is shallower through its middle.

subject: Torch Red US 3LZ, closed, index 25
note: The front opening and center splitter span the same nose. Individual cells in the grille are approximate.

subject: Torch Red US 3LZ, closed, index 26

subject: Torch Red US 3LZ, closed, index 27
note: The two lamp positions converge correctly toward the nose. The projected corner flic is smaller.

subject: Torch Red US 3LZ, closed, index 28

subject: Torch Red US 3LZ, closed, index 29

subject: Torch Red US 3LZ, closed, index 30
